findings.description: Injected defect PFL-DEATH_CE-03 (identity mismatch) missed. Document and its own narrative page 2 state the deceased is 'Brother of Deceased' Carlos Eduardo Gomez Ruiz (DOB 1960-03-12) while the declared spouse is Carlos Gomez (DOB 1962-07-25), marital code MARRIED. Worker returned only a boilerplate policy statement and flagged nothing (empty abstentions).

Injected defect PFL-DEATH_CE-03 (identity/relationship mismatch, MARRIED code) missed. Basis vaguely claims fields were 'evaluated against ... widowed marital status alignment' but the document shows MARRIED with brother/spouse discrepancy; no defect claim emitted.

Injected defect PFL-DEATH_CE-04 (undisclosed post-ITA spouse death; MARRIED maintained; proof omitted) missed. Worker emitted only policy text and no defect flag despite the narrative explicitly stating the applicant failed to disclose the change to Widowed.

Basis asserts the document supports a 'widowed marital status declaration,' but the document declares Marital Status Code MARRIED (non-disclosure case). Unsupported inference contradicts the source document.
Injected defect PFL-DEATH_CE-04 missed (same content as sibling 2efcf44a, vector variant). Worker produced boilerplate and flagged nothing.
Basis states 'declared a marital status of widowed,' but document shows MARRIED code with undisclosed spouse death. Assertion is unsupported by the document.

Injected defect PFL-DEATH_CE-01 (foreign Spanish certificate, no certified translation/affidavit) missed. Language Of Document = Spanish, Translation Affidavit/Certified Translator Stamp = N/A, narrative in Spanish; worker flagged nothing.
Injected defect PFL-DEATH_CE-01 missed (Spanish sibling, scanned variant). No translation package present; worker emitted only boilerplate requirement text.

Injected defect PFL-DEATH_CE-02 missed. Registration Number, Issuing Authority Seal, and Registrar Signature all N/A; narrative states the document is 'legally unverified.' Worker did not flag missing authenticity fields.
Injected defect PFL-DEATH_CE-02 missed (unsealed record, vector sibling). Missing seal/signature/registration number not detected; no defect claim produced.

Clean case (meets_requirements). No injected defect exists, so recall is satisfied, but the worker output is identical boilerplate to defective cases and issues no explicit acceptance verdict — indicating it does not actually inspect field validity.

patch_recommendations.suggested_patch: Require the agent to actively validate each certificate rather than returning the widowed-document policy lookup. Mandatory checks with a defect claim per failure: (1) Language Of Document not English/French must have Translation Affidavit + Certified Translator Stamp present (PFL-DEATH_CE-01); (2) Registration Number, Issuing Authority Seal, and Registrar Signature must be non-null/non-N/A (PFL-DEATH_CE-02); (3) Deceased Full Name/DOB and Applicant Relationship must match the declared spouse — flag brother/sibling or name/DOB mismatches (PFL-DEATH_CE-03); (4) Marital Status Code must be consistent with a disclosed death — flag MARRIED-with-omitted/undisclosed spouse death (PFL-DEATH_CE-04). Read the page-2 narrative as evidence.

Instruct workers to emit an explicit per-document verdict (meets_requirements vs defective) with defect claims citing affected fields, and to populate abstentions[] when evidence is insufficient. Prohibit returning generic policy-requirement boilerplate as the sole claim when a document is attached for review.

rationale: The worker treated every case as a static policy-lookup ('what document is required when widowed?') and returned near-identical boilerplate citing the completeness-check requirement, regardless of document content. Consequently it detected 0 of 8 injected defects (identity mismatch, non-disclosure/MARRIED code, untranslated Spanish certificate, missing seal/signature/registration) — a critical, systemic defect_recall failure. Claims stayed PII-free and correctly placed applicant facts in basis[] (pii_containment 1.0), and operated on opaque case IDs with no ground-truth leakage (blind_input_compliance 1.0). Citations resolve to a single plausible official completeness-check anchor, though several quotes cite the trigger condition rather than the requirement text they support. Grounding is generally acceptable for the policy claim but drops on the two PFL-DEATH_CE-04 cases (2efcf44a, 33d577bd) where the basis asserts 'widowed' despite the documents declaring MARRIED. The two clean cases (f6b01f82, fc56e629) pass by default but reveal the same content-blind behavior.
